jobs.title: Civic Data Analyst (Sustainable Mobility)
jobs.description:
Department:
Planning
Location:
Seattle, WA
Compensation:
$67,000 - $85,000 / year

Description

Alta Planning + Design seeks a Civic Data Analyst (Sustainable Mobility)
for our Seattle
office. This position is a great opportunity for someone who believes in the importance of active, multimodal, and sustainable transportation and who is interested in growing their career as a professional working at the intersection of civic data and sustainability. If you are looking to join an innovative organization and do work that connects people to places while advancing social justice, safety, and environmental resilience, apply with Alta today!

About Alta

Alta is a mission-driven company working to mitigate climate change and advance safety and social justice by shaping sustainable, people-centered communities. We bring together expertise across planning, design, engineering, education and encouragement programs, and community engagement to help communities thrive. Our work is grounded in the belief that how places are designed and experienced has a profound impact on equity, health, and opportunity—and that people should always be at the heart of those decisions.

Founded in 1996, Alta was at the forefront of the active transportation movement and has spent nearly 30 years partnering with communities to imagine a more connected, resilient, and inclusive future. Today, with more than 225 staff across the United States and beyond, we are a global leader in creating environments that support everyday life, strengthen human connection, and respond to the challenges of a changing world. Alta offers the opportunity to collaborate across disciplines, contribute to meaningful work at every scale, and be part of a team committed to making lasting, positive change for people and the places they call home.

Day to Day

Serve as a technical expert and analyst across various disciplines, project types, and regions. Develop prototypes of repeatable analysis in R, Python, and GIS to advance place-based sustainable transportation solutions. Over time, foster an entrepreneurial approach to analysis through staff training, research, tool development, and custom web applications.

Engage across Alta’s disciplines to understand data analytics needs, priorities, and expectations, fostering a data-informed decision-making culture. Lead the development of new analytical products that align with the firm's objectives and the multidisciplinary nature of the practice. Collaborate closely with planners, designers, and engineers in tasks related to data analysis and visualization, ensuring the developed solutions bring valuable mobility insights and can scale organization wide.

Delve into data analysis and visualization components of client projects and R&D efforts, employing complex methodologies. Address mobility and access challenges through innovative analytical solutions, and articulate data-driven narratives effectively through reports, technical memos, and presentations. Be proactive in identifying labor-intensive processes and analysis, exploring avenues to streamline and automate them to create organization-wide value Work on a range of projects including active transportation plans, safety action plans, complete streets planning, safe routes to school, new mobility plans, and economic benefit studies. Each day, you will keep a community-focused perspective by pushing forward solutions that help communities inform narratives about people, address multifaceted community goals, prepare communities for change, and build a more just transportation system.

Qualifications

Required

This position requires a combination of skills, experience and education including, but not limited to Bachelor’s Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or another quantitative field with demonstrated experience in the transportation planning field, OR a Bachelor’s Degree in Planning, Landscape Architecture, Environmental Sciences, or Engineering with some experience in the software development and/or data science fields.
Proficiency in Python and/or R, SQL

Proficiency in Quantitative Analysis:
A solid background in data analysis, cross tabulation, and data interpretation is essential. Candidates should be able to apply data driven techniques to inform evidence-based decision-making in planning and design contexts.
Strong understanding of databases, GIS, coding, and familiarity with transportation planning at an advanced level.
GIS Proficiency - both open-source (PostGIS, QGIS, geopandas, etc.) and the ESRI suite (ArcGISPro, Spatial Analyst, Network Analyst, etc.).
Ability to create informative data visualizations through code (e.g. D3, ggplot, matplotlib, plotly, kepler.gl, etc.).
Experience designing, implementing, and documenting analytical solutions using code. Ability to execute an analysis entirely with code.
Data specifications & database acronyms like OSM, MDS, GTFS, GBFS, GPS, CDS don’t scare you.
Proficient in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, similar products.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred
There are a number of additional skills, experience, and education that would be beneficial to this position including, but not limited to: Master’s Degree in Urban Planning, Statistics, Data Science, Engineering, Math, or Social Sciences
1+ years of experience in a consulting environment or public entity. You have experience working on responses to public sector requests for proposals.
AICP Certification.
Experience using Deltek VantagePoint.
Active participation in industry-relevant professional associations and committees.
Demonstrated work of applied statistics or machine learning techniques to transportation challenges.
Basic familiarity with deploying analytical solutions over the web with the use of Flask, Django, Fast-API, Tableau, PowerBI, ArcGIS Enterprise, or R-Shiny.

What We Offer

Flexible Schedule

Alta offers a flexible, hybrid work schedule where most employees work from home three days per week. In-office days support our collaborative culture, one of our core values.

Compensation

The pay range for this job in Seattle is $67,000-$85,000
annually. Placement within the range is based upon experience, skill-sets, and qualifications.

Benefits

Alta offers comprehensive benefits to all full-time employees: Medical
: PPO or HSA medical plans, Alta pays 75% of the cost
Dental/Vision
: PPO, Alta pays 90% of the cost
Life Insurance
: Alta pays 100% of the premium for life and AD&D, equal to your base compensation
401(k)
: Alta provides a match up to 3%
PTO
: 21 days accrued annually to start
Holidays
: 11 total company paid holidays
Paid Parental Leave/Short-Term Disability

Additional Benefits
: Wellness reimbursement up to $800 annually, Alta Gets Around benefit of up to $900 annually, 5-year travel award, and professional development opportunities

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About The Company

CharterUP is revolutionizing the $450+ billion group transportation and mobility industry with an innovative, AI-native platform that streamlines modern charter, shuttle, and autonomous vehicle operations. Trusted by numerous Fortune 500 companies, CharterUP connects enterprises, institutions, and event organizers to thousands of bus operators nationwide, serving as the core operating system for large-scale shuttle and transit programs across airports, campuses, industrial sites, and major events. By leveraging real-time availability, transparent pricing, intelligent routing, and AI-driven dispatch and optimization, CharterUP transforms a traditionally fragmented and opaque industry into one characterized by automation, accountability, and scalability.

As a rapidly growing organization recognized by Inc. as one of the fastest-growing companies, CharterUP offers a dynamic environment where innovation and impact are at the forefront. Backed by $60 million in Series A funding, the company is poised for significant expansion, providing employees with opportunities to grow professionally while contributing to industry-changing solutions. With a remote-first culture and a tech hub in Austin, TX, CharterUP fosters a collaborative and inclusive workplace dedicated to redefining group transportation.

About The Role

CharterUP is seeking an early-career Data Analyst to join our Finance Business Intelligence team. This role is ideal for someone eager to tackle complex data challenges and support the organization’s reporting and analytics needs. The Data Analyst will play a critical role in collecting, analyzing, and visualizing data to inform strategic decision-making across various departments. The position offers high visibility to leadership and the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the company's growth trajectory.

The successful candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams to develop dashboards, generate insights, and support data-driven projects. They will be responsible for managing large datasets from diverse sources, performing statistical analyses, and presenting findings in a clear and accessible manner. This role provides a platform for professional development within a fast-paced, innovative environment committed to leveraging data for strategic advantage.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Quantitative Economics, Data Science, Quantitative Finance, Computational Finance, or Finance Engineering
Master’s degree in one of the above fields (preferred)
At least 1+ year of industry experience as a Data Analyst
Proficiency in SQL, Python, or equivalent programming languages
Strong skills in Excel or Google Sheets
Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms (a plus)
Familiarity with data warehouse and ETL tools like Redshift, Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, Salesforce, or 6sense (a plus)
Experience with data manipulation, cleaning, and transformation techniques
Excellent communication skills, capable of presenting complex data insights to diverse audiences
Ability to work independently and manage multiple responsibilities effectively

Responsibilities

Collect, clean, and organize large datasets from various sources, including databases, APIs, and spreadsheets, to fulfill both ad hoc requests and recurring reporting needs
Perform comprehensive data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights that support business strategy and decision-making
Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards and reports to monitor key business metrics and performance indicators
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support data-driven initiatives and projects, ensuring alignment with organizational goals
Conduct statistical analysis and build models to forecast future trends and evaluate performance metrics
Present findings, insights, and recommendations clearly and effectively to non-technical stakeholders, including leadership
Ensure data quality and integrity throughout the analysis process
Stay updated on industry best practices and emerging data analysis tools and techniques

Benefits

Competitive base salary ranging from $70,000 to $75,000 USD
Comprehensive health benefits, including fully subsidized medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees
401(k) retirement plan with long-term financial planning support
Flexible work model supporting remote work with in-office days in Atlanta, GA (Monday, Wednesday, Friday)
Paid time off including 15 PTO days (increasing to 20 after 2 years) and 8 paid holidays (U.S. policies)
Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance where applicable
Access to top-tier technology equipment, including Mac or PC setups with monitors, keyboards, and mice
Opportunities for professional growth within a fast-moving, ambitious team
Referral bonuses for successful talent acquisition
Inclusive, supportive, and collaborative workplace culture

Equal Opportunity

CharterUP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible, and respectful workplace environment. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws in the United States and Canada.
